posts.title: HTTP Integrity Digests: Past, Present, and Future
posts.description: The core HTTP specifications don’t define their own means of providing integrity. Although “hop-by-hop” protocols underneath HTTP, such as TLS or QUIC, provide integrity for HTTP message transactions, it isn’t enough.
